text:
taylor (new-hire): hey team, day 2 question: I can open Grafana dashboards but when I try to add myself to alert notifications in Datadog the UI greys out the channel. I also tried to open a Sentry issue link from our onboarding doc and got "You don't have permission to view this project". who do I ping for what?
sam (devex): welcome! short answer: two separate permission flows. For Datadog alert channels we rely on the Datadog<->Slack integration and a Datadog role for monitor edits. For Sentry you need project membership. Start by filing the access form for each tool so approvers route correctly.
jess (observability): quick checklist: 1) Datadog: can you see Monitors -> All Monitors? if yes, then likely only the "post to channel" integration is missing. 2) Grafana: are you trying to save a dashboard or just star it? 3) Sentry: what URL did you open? sometimes onboarding links point to staging projects.
taylor (new-hire): I can see Monitors list and metrics, just the channel dropdown is empty. Grafana I only want to star a dashboard (star button is disabled). Sentry link is https://sentry.redwood.company/organizations/redwood/issues/112233/.
ben (infra): Datadog channel dropdown empty = the Slack app hasn't been granted permission for that channel. infra manages which channels the Datadog integration can post to. File an access request: https://redwood.company/internal/access-requests -> select 'Datadog - Post to Slack Channel' and include channel name. We'll add the integration on our side.
sam (devex): For Grafana star/save: that usually means the dashboard lives in a locked folder. Quick workaround: Dashboard -> Share -> Export -> Save JSON, then Grafana -> + -> Import -> upload JSON and save into your personal folder. If you'll be editing a lot, request 'Grafana - Dashboard Edit' from the access form.
jess (observability): For Sentry: that URL is a prod issue. If you get project permission denied, request 'sentry-project-read' and include the project slug (you can get slug from the onboarding doc or the URL - in your link the project is the org context "redwood" and issue id 112233; include the full URL in the request). Approvers will add you to that project team.
taylor (new-hire): thanks, filing three access requests now. small question: any way to test the Datadog->Slack hook without triggering a real monitor?
ben (infra): yes — use the "Send test notification" button inside the monitor editor. Alternatively, you can create a temporary monitor with a query that always triggers (e.g., avg(last_1h):sum:system.uptime{host:nonexistent} > 0) then remove it. Use test monitors sparingly.
taylor (new-hire): filed requests: Datadog channel add (#eng-alerts) ID #4901, Grafana edit ID #4902, Sentry read ID #4903. Thanks!
access-bot: Access requests #4901,#4902,#4903 created. Routing: infra/approvers. ETA 1 business day.
taylor (new-hire): appreciate the quick guidance :pray: will update when I have access and try the export/import trick if needed.
